convert_float_to_apot: convert a floating point value to an APoT index using quantization levels and alpha clipping
quantize_float_value: quantize a floating point value to the nearest reduced precision level from a set of quantization levels
dequantize_apot_index: convert an APoT index back to its corresponding floating point value from quantization levels
test_float_to_apot_clipping: test the float_to_apot function with values outside the alpha range to verify clipping behavior
refactor_quant_dequant_util: refactor the quant_dequant_util function to support numpy arrays for batch quantization
